url.description: Absolute URL for the content. The scheme identifies the retrieval method.

expires.description: Time after which this addr is no longer valid. Defaults to, and is capped by, the record's expires.

addr.description: One location that serves the content.

size.description: Size of the content in bytes.

expires.description: Time after which this record is no longer valid. Ceiling for the expiry of every addr.

main.description: An announcement that the content identified by the DASL or BDASL CID in the record key is retrievable at one or more URLs, until an expiry time.
